Description: The passage widens into a pulsing organic chamber. At its center, a massive fungal brain, easily the size of a house, hangs suspended by thousands of tendrils. Every strand twitches in time with a rhythm you can feel in your teeth.

Replies.ReplyText: Attempt to commune with the hivemind.
Replies.FlText: The hivemind recoils from your touch, lashing out with a wave of agony.
Replies.SsText: The hivemind opens to you, and you glimpse the shape of the Mycelarch. A tithe of the hive's memory settles into your mind, as a gift.
The nexus screams and the hive answers.

Replies.FlText: The tendrils thrash and the nexus screams, drawing the hive down on your heads.
Replies.SsText: You hack the tendrils apart and the nexus goes still. Its drained reservoirs pour out as a glistening treasure.
